title: Sodium's yellow line
caption: The 3p level lies 2.105 eV above the 3s ground state. An electron falling between them emits a photon of λ = hc/ΔE = 589 nm, the yellow of sodium street lamps.
alt: Energy levels of sodium: 3s at minus 5.14 electronvolts and 3p at minus 3.03, with a downward arrow emitting 589 nanometre yellow light.
description: λ = 1239.84 eV nm / 2.105 eV = 589 nm, in the visible (yellow).
